title: fabric-interop: the structuredContent of a queue-full refusal at a job's start and of unknown-job (DEC-0104)
description: A refusal that started nothing and stored nothing: queue-full at a job's start (with its data), or unknown-job for an id the callee never issued or another caller's job. Only these two; a provider's other refusals keep their own shapes. The error is interop-common's, so queue-full's data is bound here.
